categories_thin: Pharmacies: two independents are confirmed in the borough (Milltown Pharmacy, 21 N Main St, 732-828-0080; Quick Mart Pharmacy, 100 Ryders Ln, 732-745-7222) but pharmacy is an excluded category under the brief, so they are not listed.

Physician practices: the only primary-care office found is Saint Peter's Physician Associates at 72 Washington Ave, part of a large health system and therefore excluded; AFC Urgent Care (352 Ryders Ln) is a franchise and also excluded.

Veterinarians: no veterinary practice inside the borough; the only animal-health presence is a pet-store vaccination clinic at 300 Ryders Ln (chain), with full-service hospitals in East Brunswick (out of zone).

Insurance brokers: only Berg and Volk have in-borough evidence. PFT&K Insurance Brokers (86 Washington Ave) and Robert P. Petri & Daughter (258 Ryders Ln) appear only in single directory pages with conflicting phone numbers, so they were left out pending confirmation.
Tutoring/test prep, driving schools, art schools, event venues, hotels: nothing located inside the borough in any source; the tutoring and test-prep centres that serve Milltown are in East Brunswick.

Manufacturing/wholesale/logistics: only directory-only names (Middlesex Container, Bannister, Priority Distribution, Lines & Signs); the Ford Ave industrial pocket is small and no operating evidence beyond a directory was found.
Staffing, surveying, environmental and appraisal firms: none found in any source for the borough.
caveats: Milltown is ~1.6 sq mi. Businesses were kept to streets confirmed inside the borough (N Main St, S Main St, Ryders Ln, Riva Ave, Washington Ave, Van Liew Ave, W Church St, W Lakewood Ave, Ford Ave, Cleveland Ave, Dorothy Ln, Tracey Dr, Clay St, Pershing Ave, Richter Ave, Cottage Ave, Highland Dr, Booream Ave).

Google Maps in the visitor browser caps results at roughly five per query ('limited view'); coverage was rebuilt from ~22 distinct category sweeps plus NJTGO, the BestProsInTown 41-profile town index, Birdeye, Gyms NJ and LocalFlowerShop directories, Yellow Pages/BBB/D&B profiles and a town sponsor page, so some home-based businesses are likely still missing.
